rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken verb for showing strong respect or reverence.

example.english: I continue to revere my grandmother.
example.traditional: 我一直都好尊敬我阿嫲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 zyun1 ging3 ngo5 aa3 maa4

rows.note: Use this when reverence is expressed as intense admiration or idolization rather than solemn awe.

example.english: When I was young, I used to revere that singer.
example.traditional: 細個嗰陣，我成日崇拜嗰個歌手。
example.jyutping: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ngo5 seng4 jat6 sung4 baai3 go2 go3 go1 sau2

rows.note: Use this for the awe-filled or fear-tinged side of reverence.

example.english: We should revere nature with a sense of awe.
example.traditional: 我哋面對大自然時，應該存住一份敬畏。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 min6 deoi3 daai6 zi6 jin4 si4 jing1 goi1 cyun4 zyu6 jat1 fan6 ging3 wai3
